title: Settings
subtitle: Configure the workspace and keyboard-first controls.
workspaceHelp: Enter any URL that Electron can load, including local HTTP pages, LAN pages, and pages with their own authentication or permissions. The https:// prefix is added automatically when omitted.
windowHelp: Enable drag mode to move the workspace window by dragging anywhere in it, and to resize it freely from its edges. While drag mode is on, clicks and scrolling in the workspace move the window instead of reaching the page.
shortcutsHelp: Each command uses one physical key combination. Select Record and press the new combination.
discardPrompt: Save your changes before closing settings?
languageHelp: Choose the display language. Follow system uses your operating system language.

notices.captureHint: Press a key combination. Escape cancels recording.
notices.capturePrintable: A printable key must include Ctrl, Cmd, Alt, or Shift.
notices.dragModeFailed: Drag mode could not be changed.
